C1311.title: 67 Sentenced in Ningxia Xiji Cross-Border Pig-Butchering Scam Case
C1311.summary: The first-instance verdict in a major cross-border telecom fraud case supervised by the Ministry of Public Security was delivered by the Xiji County Court in Ningxia. Sixty-seven defendants, including ringleader Zeng Ying, were convicted of fraud and illegally crossing the national border.
